japan.label: Within the limit
japan.rule: Lorazepam is on Japan’s list of psychotropics. You can carry up to 90 mg in total for your own use with no paperwork.
japan.whatToDo: More than that: carry a certificate from your doctor naming the illness, why you need the medicine, and the medicines and amounts. More than a month’s supply: contact Japan’s health ministry (yakkan@mhlw.go.jp).

korea.label: Paperwork before you fly
korea.rule: Lorazepam is a controlled medicine in Korea (a psychotropic). You need a permit from Korea’s Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS) before you arrive.
korea.whatToDo: Submit the complete application at least 10 working days before you arrive (weekends and Korean public holidays don’t count): two application forms, a full passport copy, your flight booking, a letter from your doctor and your prescription. A permit covers up to 90 days; you can ask for up to 5 extra days’ doses in case of delays. Carry it in your hand luggage. Only the person who takes the medicine can get the permit.

china.label: No set amount
china.rule: China lists lorazepam as a Category II psychotropic. You may bring an amount that fits your prescription; there’s no set number.
china.whatToDo: Carry your prescription or a diagnosis certificate from your doctor, and declare it to customs (the red channel).

japan.label: Paperwork before you fly
japan.rule: Lisdexamfetamine is a “stimulants’ raw material” in Japan: allowed only with permission from Japan’s Narcotics Control Department before you travel.
japan.whatToDo: Apply at least 14 days before you arrive, to the office for your arrival airport: the application form, a medical certificate from your doctor (issued within 3 months, with the specific reason) and photos of the packaging. Carry it yourself. Leaving Japan with leftovers needs an export form too.

china.whatToDo: Ask the Chinese embassy or consulate near you before you pack it.

japan.label: Paperwork before you fly
japan.rule: Codeine is a narcotic in Japan. Products with 1% codeine or less are excluded; a tablet with 30 mg of codeine would have to weigh 3 g or more to be under that.
japan.whatToDo: Unless you can confirm your product has 1% codeine or less, apply to Japan’s Narcotics Control Department at least 14 days before you arrive, with a medical certificate and photos of the packaging.

japan.label: Within the limit
japan.rule: Prescription medicines: you can bring up to a one-month supply for your own use with no paperwork.
japan.whatToDo: More than a month’s supply needs an Import Confirmation (Yunyu Kakunin-sho, once called “Yakkan Shoumei”) before you leave home. The US Embassy suggests carrying a copy of your prescription.

korea.label: Within the limit
korea.rule: Ordinary medicines: up to 6 bottles or a 3-month supply. You must be able to show they’re for your own use: a prescription, a medical certificate or the pharmacy label.
korea.whatToDo: Keep them in the original packaging. You may be asked for a receipt.

japan.whatToDo: Leave it at home unless the maker certifies its THC is below Japan’s limits.

korea.label: Not allowed

korea.whatToDo: Leave it at home.

china.rule: Marijuana is prohibited in China, and we haven’t found an official rule on CBD for travellers. Hong Kong has treated CBD as a dangerous drug since 1 Feb 2023.
china.whatToDo: Leave it at home.
